# Sean Herbert

> Sean Herbert is a senior full-stack developer (PHP, WordPress, WooCommerce, C#/.NET) with 15+ years of experience, based at Blackbird Digital Inc., where he is Director of Technology. He has built 800+ WordPress sites and 350+ WooCommerce sites, and recently ships privacy-first, self-hosted products.

## Site

- [Portfolio](https://www.seanherbert.me/): About, selected projects, work experience and skills
- [Contact](https://www.seanherbert.me/contact): Contact form for project enquiries

## Selected projects

- [WP Local Consent](https://wplocalconsent.com): WordPress cookie consent plugin and script blocker that runs entirely from the site's own assets, with Google Consent Mode v2 support
- [WP Local Accessibility](https://wplocalaccessibility.com): WordPress accessibility toolkit (visitor toolbar, on-site scanner, accessibility statement) with no third-party calls or telemetry
- PixelVault: self-hosted, privacy-first photo and video organizer built on ASP.NET Core (.NET 10)
- MedTrack: personal medication efficacy tracker built with Next.js, Supabase and Flutter
